desktop.notes:
• The same Library as Curish and Wildframe: Send to Library now goes to Dropbox\projects\PhotoLibrary by default (Pictures\Library on a computer without Dropbox) - the folder the other apps use. A folder you chose yourself in Settings stays as it is.
• Photos added by hand (copied into the Library in Explorer): sending the same photo from Cullect no longer makes a "(1)" copy - its data goes next to the file that is already there. Culling a folder inside the Library never moves files into _keep / _discarded (your decisions are saved; Curish and the other apps keep finding the files).
• Where each photo came from is kept in its data: the folder, the drive's name, the drive's serial number and the path on the drive - so it is found again when the card or drive gets another letter - and which program brought it.
• Saving a photo's data retries for a moment when Windows briefly holds the file (antivirus, Dropbox).
